critical.issue: Returns 400 'Mercado cerrado' for crypto symbols (SOLUSD, etc.) when forex market is closed (weekend). Spec: crypto trades 24/7. Root cause: /app/backend/routers/shared_routes.py line 78 calls fx_market_open() for any profile symbol without a crypto bypass. Also the friday_stage/close_before_weekend check on line 80 lacks a crypto bypass. Suggested fix: `if getattr(engine, 'profile', None) and body.symbol not in CRYPTO and not fx_market_open(): ...` and same for the friday_stage branch (import CRYPTO from fx.symbols).

action_items: Fix /api/pepper/manual-order weekend gating: skip fx_market_open() and friday_stage() checks when body.symbol is in CRYPTO (import CRYPTO from fx.symbols). Without this fix, users cannot open paper positions on crypto during the weekend even though crypto is advertised as 24/7.
Remove the 'Chatea con IA expert' header button from the Pepperstone dashboard only (keep for HotForex/Bybit).

After the manual-order fix, re-run the FE playbook: open paper BUY on SOLUSD, verify position-card-<id> data-testid fields (position-opened-<id>, position-pnl-<id>), position-chart-btn-<id> → position-chart-dialog with canvas and 'Entrada/SL/EMA 9/EMA 21' legend, GET /api/pepper/positions/<id>/candles shape (candles, ema9, ema21, entry, sl, opened), card responsiveness at 390x844 and 1920x800 (no overflow), close-position-<id>, and trade-analyze-btn-<id> in Historial.
critical_code_review_comments: shared_routes.manual_order couples the Friday/weekend gate to the profile (fx vs pepper) rather than to the symbol class — this directly contradicts the 'crypto 24/7' requirement. The engine-level entry path (_handle_test_signal, covered by test_iter101) already bypasses friday for crypto; the manual-order path must do the same.

The dialog on the main chart still exposes a TAKE PROFIT · DISTANCIA / PRECIO TP field for Pepperstone. The product requirement is 'NO take profit; exit = opposite EMA cross or TOQUE_EMA'. Consider hiding TP on Pepperstone or at least labelling the dialog so the user understands the bot will close on the next opposite cross regardless.

rca of the issue: manual-order Mercado-cerrado on crypto: /app/backend/routers/shared_routes.py:78 gates every symbol behind fx_market_open() whenever the engine has a profile (i.e. fx or pepper). CRYPTO symbols live in the Pepperstone profile but are 24/7 instruments; the engine's auto path already skips the Friday/weekend block for CRYPTO in fx.engine_signals.py but the manual chart-button path was missed. Fix: `from fx.symbols import CRYPTO`; `if getattr(engine,'profile',None) and body.symbol not in CRYPTO and not fx_market_open(): raise HTTPException(400,'Mercado cerrado')`; same crypto bypass on the friday_stage() branch (line 80). Reproduction: curl -X POST /api/pepper/manual-order {symbol:'SOLUSD', side:'long', sl:68.59, tp:73.76, atr:0.86, risk_pct:0.9} on a Saturday → HTTP 400 'Mercado cerrado' (expected: 200 with the new position). Confirmed on preview.
